text:
This place of worship has been
turned into its opposite. Roll d6 to
determine what is going on:
1-3) Human sacrifice! There are 2d6
L2 cultists. You may choose to
Escape but if you do, you lose 2
Sanity and there is a 2 in 6 chance
of a cultist chasing you to fight.
Every time you come back to the
church, roll a 2 in 6 chance that they
are still there.
4-5) There is no one in the church
right now. If you know an exorcism,
you may re-consecrate the church
with a L5 Magic roll. Add +1 if you
have the Occultism and +2 if you
have Occultism at Expert level. If
the Save fails, a random monster
from the Demonic Horrors Table
will attack you. If you re-consecrate
the church, increase permanently
your Sanity by 1 (this is a
permanent increase), gain 1 XP and
find 2 vials of holy water.

6) Save vs. L4 curse (add +1 if you
have the Will Skill, +2 if you have it
at Expert level). If you fail, you are
Cursed. You will be at -1 on all saves
until you perform any action that
increases your Sanity (like 4-5
above). When that happens, the
curse will be broken. You may also
find rituals or magic item letting
you remove a curse.

zh-CN.title: 2 - 亵渎的教堂
text:
这座礼拜场所已被彻底扭曲，变成了与其本意相反的地方。掷1D6决定这里发生了什么：
1–3）活人献祭！有2D6名L2邪教徒。你可以选择逃跑，但会损失2点理智，并有2/6的概率被一名邪教徒追上并与之战斗。每次你回到教堂，都掷骰检查他们是否仍在此处，概率为2/6。
4–5）此刻教堂里没有人。若你会驱魔术，可以进行一次L5魔法检定重新祝圣教堂；拥有神秘学技能时加值+1，神秘学达到专家级时加值+2。若检定失败，一只从恶魔恐怖生物表随机确定的怪物会攻击你。若成功重新祝圣，你的理智上限永久提高1点，获得1点经验，并找到2瓶圣水。
6）进行一次L4诅咒防御检定（拥有意志技能时+1，专家级时+2）。失败则受到诅咒：在你采取任何能提高理智的行动（例如上文4–5的做法）之前，所有防御检定均-1。理智提高时诅咒解除。你也可以寻找能解除诅咒的仪式或魔法物品。
